content: Yonee odoo howo oluguli odoo oso to taka
Osoloso Yesu Nasalet mi mapoo badoboome, Yonee odoo howo oluguli odoo oso sibileso Yudiya miwe poogoo mi mapoo Godeeyo to egeesee takomo siliso,
“Niba goo goolee su wudoloso nibada tokenee maga miligi pie. Bei, Godeeye wiligi doloso badeli goo oso sibilei olo koola tooboo,” dee takomo siliso.
Esiga Yonee odoo howo oluguli odoo eyo goo maga Godee maga to toloso kokodo takomo sili odoo Aisayaye egeesee takaso,

content.text: “Odoo heeso miwe poogoo mi omaga egeesee idagoo,
Osoloso o eli medee hoodo magee,’ dee takomoloso.”

content: Yonee yo kemol be too oso dugo dusa kaloso silone, gala koloso bagi mapoo gudu masi kaloso siliso. Osoloso nei yayo nali ee tapala sabolo koo sabolo nali.
Odoo susuga oso Yelusalem abaga osoloso Yudiya abaga osoloso Yoden howo palaga debeli mi maga Yoneeye taka to ee dulame sibadeeso.
Diba Yoneeye taka to ee duloso dibada goo tokenee yilige bugume, Yoneeye diba Yoden howo mapoo howo oluguso.

Esino Yoneeye odoo howo olugumolome, Pelisi odoo susuga sabolo osoloso Sedisi odoo susuga sibileso omapoo peledabaso. Eseme Yoneeye diba ogoloso dimapoo egeesee takaso, “Niba hebise, nimapoo odoo agayo takolone, niba Godeeye kamana goo egee sibo maga mada pia dabalai teiba, dee ka takana?
Esiga niyo debei goo maga nibada goo tokenee mapoo tei miligi pia goo ee eligi.

Osoloso niba niso nediliyo niba Eibalahameeyo amawe dioga, Godeeye kamana goo maga mada pia dabalaiso, dee na goolee. Bei, ayo nimapoo taka. Godee yimapoo kitulugu moloso, yo hagoso see Eibalahameeyo amawe dio palai.
Esiga kabee homo bei mapoo olo magoo moloso. Esiga homo kaso ko tekepo pelega mologa, homo egee holoso dou mapoo toodalaiso.

Nibada goo tokenee goo mapoo miligi pia maga ayo niba wulo howodee mapoo oluguso. Esino odoo ama hamamee egee sibo oso Dio Tei nima kulodu tenelaiso. Osoloso yayo yimapoo tei tele poogoo odoo ee dou mapoo toodalaiso. Esiga yayo kitulugu oso a dagadi. Esiga ayo o homo mapoo kali bi ee todilei a tebile.
Yayo witi wo ko sabolo osoloso so ee pilame o tou teli bi mopoodoo doloso badoso. Osoloso witi wo ko ee mosopoo kukuleiso. Osoloso witi wo so ee dou koo semili mapoo toodalaiso,” diso.
Biame domo omapoo Yesu Gelili mi maga Yoden howo mapoo Yoneeye yo howo olugulame simiso.
Esino Yoneeye Yesu yo howo olugulei gowoolone yimapoo egeesee takaso, “Bei kasi maga no ayo howo olugulame amapoo ka simiyo? Nayo a howo olugulei tekepo,” diso.
Eseme nei Yesuye yimapoo egeesee takaso, “Epedee hamapoo nayo a howo olugulei tekepo. Bei, goo hagee Godeeye goomoga goo oso,” diso. Eseme Yonee to hagee duloso Yesu howo oluguso.
Osoloso Yesu howo oluguloso gasibileso tobudulone egeino, Kei mi osulu yamagoloso Dio Tei oso molo masi pusibileso yimapoo pubalegeme egeiso.
Eseme Kei mi ma dokodooga toso egeesee taka, “Hagee ayo diya gooma mo Holo oso. Ayo yimapoo diya goomogo,” dee takaso.
